scenario_generation.ignored_request_contract: task_status=1 and user_status=0; INSIST becomes action-valid only after no_response_count reaches 2
scenario_generation.method: seeded shuffled scenario blocks with probabilistic scenario inclusion

stimulus_alignment_note: Heuristic engineering diagnostic for broad stimulus/action compatibility only; not a validated animal-behaviour model or measure of perceived believability.
temporal_model: Each non-terminal decision uses a seeded elapsed-time interval sampled uniformly from 0.5 to 5 simulated seconds. Paired agents share intervals. Physical energy receives action effort costs and passive time-based drain (0.0025 per second normally; 0.0008 while resting). The shared energy value is observable to both agents and included in both state representations. Proposed-agent affect decays over the interval before the next state is built for Q-learning.

training_diagnostics.aggregation_level: all decisions across all completed episodes in this run

q_value_analysis.repeated_action_minus_best_alternative_g: best_alternative_q_minus_repeated_action_q; positive means the best alternative has higher learned value

metric_definitions.insist_environment_execution_attempts: Count of INSIST actions passed into applyEnvironmentAction; this is an attempt, not proof of acceptance.
metric_definitions.insist_final_selections_after_overrides: Count where the final selected action is INSIST.
metric_definitions.insist_policy_selections_before_override: Count where the policy action before proposed-agent overrides is INSIST.
metric_definitions.insist_predicate_eligible_decisions: Count of observations for which isActionValidForObservation(INSIST, observation) is true.
metric_definitions.insist_valid_action_available_decisions: Count of observations where INSIST appears in validActionsForObservation.
metric_definitions.repeated_action_vs_best_alternative_gap: Best alternative valid-action Q estimate minus the repeated action Q estimate, sampled on repeated-category decisions with Q-table support; positive means the alternative has higher Q.
metric_definitions.repetition_penalty_trigger_count: Count of decisions where the shared repetition penalty is greater than zero.
metric_definitions.within_state_valid_action_value_spread: Maximum minus minimum Q estimate across valid actions for a decision with at least one stored valid action value; unvisited action entries may have the QTable default value.

q_value_analysis.repeated_action_minus_best_alternative_g: best_alternative_q_minus_repeated_action_q; positive means the best alternative has higher learned value
